## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 63 bloated prose blocks are confirmed in 13 paths under tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/. Condense redundant or historical text while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Use d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84 only for inventory/citations. Implement current origin/main as one commit. Compare committed HEAD^ and HEAD for executable and protected-prose equality, and HEAD^..HEAD for paths.

## Boundary and guards
Edit only listed blocks and adjacent blank lines; currentize historical and scaffolding prose. Keep executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose unchanged.

AST-parse committed HEAD^ and HEAD with type_comments=True. Sentinel only the 54 Scope-named owner docstrings, normalize ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require equal dumps without attributes. All other docstrings and runtime structure remain compared.

Tokenize both trees and group contiguous comments by innermost AST owner. Resolve the nine HEAD^ blocks by unique Scope openings and record owner plus ordinal. Require equal per-owner counts in HEAD, sentinel only those positions, and compare all other owners, ordinals, columns, and token bytes. Separately compare directive text and attachment. This permits selected line-count changes but rejects deletion, splitting, or neighboring-prose edits.
